scope: Registered experiment definitions E1–E20: the question and controlled comparison, the primary readout, the decision interpretation and the reporting scope. 'displays' lists the identifiers of the displays named in the reporting scope; the generator checks them against paper/display_manifest.json. Placeholders are filled from the full configurations and registered constants.

E1.question: nominal identity: native execution vs adapter nominal, native-only vs inserted-site variant
E1.readout: prediction and state difference; per-site work
E1.interpretation: an interface that fails identity is excluded from the class

E2.question: predictability: fit the initial-input predictor of the feedback policy's executed sequences on D_explore
E2.readout: two readouts kept apart: ϕ_x^seq, the share of executed sequences reproduced, and ϕ_x^gain, the paired share of the feedback gain retained by executing the predicted sequences
E2.interpretation: ϕ_x^gain is the quantity compared with the crossovers of Table S47 (Proposition 10); ϕ_x^seq is descriptive

E3.question: initial-input schedule predictor at the ceiling
E3.readout: paired loss vs q_C and vs feedback
E3.interpretation: feedback must beat a genuinely input-conditioned policy
E3.scope: Tables S46–S46b; main Fig. 6; Fig. S3; power: Tables S42, S47

E4.question: initial-input distillation
E4.readout: retained gain; student and execution cost
E4.interpretation: most gain transferring implies schedule learning, not indispensable online feedback

E5.question: no-observation replanning with matched model calls
E5.interpretation: separates observation value from repeated search

E6.question: selective sensing: periodic / gap trigger / learned trigger at the same actions and budget
E6.readout: acquisition rate, retained gain, late-abort rate, runtime tail
E6.interpretation: a lower sensing rate is not itself an accuracy improvement
E6.scope: Tables S34, S46–S46b; boundary-case tests of Algorithm S3 (Fig. S11)

E7.question: spectral specificity: full / deleted / scrambled bands at matched capacity and work
E7.readout: action-ranking error, warning lead, complete-policy loss
E7.interpretation: bands retained only with incremental value
E7.scope: Table S17; band-power audit of E18

E8.question: observer specificity: raw / EMA / global / conditioned / history MLP
E8.readout: innovation error and decision outcomes separately
E8.interpretation: a read-only observer must preserve predictions

E9.question: search versus model error: exact enumeration for H ≤ 4
E9.interpretation: beam suboptimality is evaluated, not assumed zero

E10.question: separated data-use sequence: confirmation on D_confirm, independent arms on D_compare, admission on the untouched validation split; re-clipped sensitivity
E10.readout: moments, tails, raw harm, U_a; Holm family re-formed
E10.interpretation: interpretation requires the common-unit checks of Note S24
E10.scope: main Table 1; Table S14b; Fig. S18b; Note S26

E11.question: dependence sensitivity: cores, buffers, isolation
E11.interpretation: no independent-graph guarantee on single graphs

E12.question: retraining-allowed alternatives rerun
E12.readout: measured score, SD, work and fitting cost (Table S15b)

E13.question: attribution of inserted-site transport: native designated sites only / inserted sites under the strongest open-loop schedule / inserted sites under the confirmed feedback route, at matched expected cost, on the GraphGPS-style and GINE-style plants
E13.readout: paired differences between arms with intervals
E13.interpretation: an arm without feedback that matches the feedback arm within ε_eq removes the feedback label on that plant; a native-only arm that matches removes the insertion mechanism

E14.question: comparator on the extended ensemble grid E ∈ {extended_grid} with paired seeds; E = {beyond_registered} require that many distinct checkpoints, counted separately from repeated evaluations
E14.readout: D̂∞ by least squares; equal-compute verdicts of Table S26
E14.interpretation: thresholds of main Proposition 5 evaluated at D̂∞; a verdict requires the evaluated grid

E15.question: selection trace: the candidate-level ledger of main Eq. (19) with feasibility masks, complexity ordering, ensemble sizes and profiles, replayed under the documented rule
E15.readout: every selected configuration and |Q_s| reproduced, or the implemented rule identified
E15.interpretation: the margin is not changed to reproduce preferred outcomes; a rule that differs from the documented one is reported as the rule (Table S12c)
E15.scope: Table S12c; selector trace of the run archive

E16.question: uncertainty hierarchy: the resampling procedure that produced every interval (graphs, clusters, splits, optimization seeds), with the {plant_seeds} seeds' assignment to ensembles and repeated evaluations
E16.readout: paired intervals recomputed under the documented hierarchy, pairing between methods preserved
E16.interpretation: intervals for a fixed deployed ensemble across new graphs are stated separately from intervals across repeated training; descriptive admission statistics computed on their designated observations

E17.question: timing protocol: repetitions, warm-up, synchronization, batch size, device placement and normalization for every latency entry; mean and tail latency from the traces behind the final figures; actual parameters, work, wall time and fitting cost per retained external baseline
E17.readout: Tables S15b and S23 reconciled on one execution object; main Fig. 4f from measured latencies; observed per-input maximum of C_controller, kept apart from the modelled C_0.99; executed sensor parameters (k, P_s, f_res)
E17.interpretation: every latency entry carries its execution object
E17.scope: Tables S15b, S23, S44, S6c; main Table 2

E18.question: spectral displacement audit of main Proposition 6: for each application, the common operator, graph assumptions, degree weighting (H_ℓ against D^1/2 H_ℓ), retained windows, total state energy, omitted-band contribution, approximation error and native-update constants; predicted against observed one-step action displacement
E18.readout: predicted-vs-observed displacement; incremental action ranking and policy value over matched confidence/history controls
E18.interpretation: the displacement conclusion stays separate from any predictive-improvement claim

E19.question: per-cell support recomputation: ESS_c and ω_max,c from the logged weights of every (stratum, action) cell on one weight vector, with the behaviour-policy propensities
E19.readout: per-cell statistics, support masks, qualified fractions, and the propagation of any changed mask through Q_feas, selection and the cost ledger
E19.interpretation: mask-dependent quantities use the common per-cell support definition (Table S7)

E20.question: Full/Lean profiles and the inserted-site parameters: paired results of the executable Full and Lean configurations at their actual costs
E20.readout: paired loss, work and latency per profile
E20.interpretation: narrows the role of the profiles to what is measured
